Any threshold change requires re-signoff + config/runplan/budget SHA refresh (ADR-0033 §6 rule 1). fix-5 2026-10-30 (C4): WP0 authoring complete; formal signoff pending owner re-affirm; reviewer (oracle_reviewer) is NOT a signatory; statistics/evaluation signoff belongs to main_session_owner, not the Oracle. gate-0 A5 2026-10-30 (P3 lane D): this template is the TEMPLATE of the t1_start_requires record requirement preregistration_signoff_record — the INSTANCE at outputs/pesn/v542_backbone_50k/plan/preregistration_signoff.json is machine-checked by the schema validator (prereg: t1_blocked reason; --formal: typed V542_RECORD_MISSING / V542_RECORD_MISMATCH on threshold drift). gate-3 B2/C2 2026-10-30 (P3 remediation lane R2): the validator now ALSO requires the instance to mirror the frozen config — config_path must equal config/campaigns/pes2ts_v542_backbone_50k.yaml, campaign_id/gv_campaign_id/schema must equal PES2TS_V542_BACKBONE_50K / V5.4.2 / pes2ts_v542_preregistration_signoff_v1, signed_by_roles must be EXACTLY the frozen role-key set (statistics_owner/evaluation_signoff = main_session_owner, oracle_reviewer = oracle_gate0_reviewer; an empty mapping is a typed rejection), the thresholds_signed_frozen block must be byte-equal to the config thresholds (canonical-JSON comparison), and the declared record_sha256 must equal sha256(canonical_bytes(instance payload without record_sha256)) via the identity module's ONE recipe (pes2ts_core.pesn.models.v542.identity.canonical_bytes); a missing digest is V542_RECORD_MISSING, a wrong digest is V542_RECORD_MISMATCH. The sibling runplan_pin_record is verified by the WP5 runner at the runplan freeze, NOT by this validator at WP0.

gate_preregistration.H2_rule: 每正式 seed: RMSE/zero 退化 <=2% 相对 R3 且退化 <=2% 相对同 seed matched A0; sign 绝对下降 <=0.01; dead 绝对增加 <=0.01; fixed-coverage direction 相对退化 <=2%; R3 参照必须同 evaluator/环境可重评, 否则 T1 阻断
gate_preregistration.H3_rule: 对照 matched A0 (非 R3): 路线判定用冻结括号逻辑 (config evaluation_contract.route_logic) — MOVE pass = (direction_pass AND rmse_non_inferior) OR (rmse_pass AND direction_non_inferior) (direction_pass: fixed-coverage direction 相对>=3% 且绝对>=0.01; rmse_pass: RMSE/zero 相对改善>=3%; rmse_non_inferior: 退化<=2%; direction_non_inferior: 退化<=2%); PROCESS pass = (auprc_pass AND q_non_inferior) OR (q_pass AND auprc_non_inferior) (auprc_pass: ΔAUPRC>=0.02; q_pass: Δq>=0.03; auprc_non_inferior: 下降<=0.01; q_non_inferior: 下降<=0.02); >=2/3 seeds 同向且每 seed 无 H2 breach; seed-averaged curve paired bootstrap 10000 draws (bootstrap_seed_root=20261029, 子 seed 公式 int(sha256(f"v542|{root}|{seed}|{endpoint}").hexdigest()[:16],16) % 2147483647, CI 与 p 同一组 draws); p = (1 + #{seed-averaged paired bootstrap improvement <= 0}) / (10001) one-sided improvement (direction/AUPRC/q: candidate-A0; RMSE: A0-candidate); Holm family 冻结: MOVE direction 与 MOVE RMSE 两 exit 各 alpha=0.025 各自对 eligible candidate 集 Holm, PROCESS 单一 family 对 2 endpoints x eligible candidates Holm (family alpha=0.025); eligible = 完成三 seed 且每 seed H2 无 breach 的 winner-eligible candidate; qualification = adjusted p < 对应 alpha 且效应/非劣条件成立; 冠军 = H3-qualified 集内按 final_selection_rule 冻结字典序选定; 报告未校正与校正后; 任何收益不豁免 H2
gate_preregistration.final_selection_rule: 候选资格 = H3-qualified only (A0/diagnostic 不参加); 0 个 => A0 留任 (no_backbone_winner); 恰 1 个 => 选它; 多个 => 冻结字典序: (1) route priority: MOVE-qualified 优先于 PROCESS-only; (2) qualifying 确认性 endpoint 的 Holm-adjusted p 最小者; (3) qualifying endpoint 的 effect margin 最大者 (MOVE direction=min(rel/0.03,abs/0.01), MOVE RMSE=rel/0.03, PROCESS AUPRC=delta/0.02, PROCESS q=delta/0.03); (4) core_time_ratio 较小; (5) active backbone params 较小; (6) inner-val total loss 较小; (7) candidate_id 字典序较小; 不使用 dev; 报告所有 H3-qualified 候选; 完整 rule block 进 statistics/final-selection SHA 与 run identity; A5-C activation 仅用被选 candidate
gate_preregistration.diagnostic_rule: seed17 2,000 (400+1600) 只对 A0@2000 粗筛: H0/H1 失败/loss 非有限/梯度 NaN 淘汰; loss 降幅<5% 或 dead>A0@2000+0.20 淘汰; RMSE/zero 相对 A0@2000 退化>10% 淘汰; 不套用 H3 3% 效应量; 诊断不进排名
gate_preregistration.seed17_screen_pass_rule: 筛选 predicate (非三 seed H3 声明): run done 且指标有限; H0/H1/diagnostic/cost<=2 全过; matched A0_S17 已完成; seed17 H2 全 guard 无 breach; point effect 至少一路, 显式复用 route_logic 括号逻辑 (PROCESS (auprc_pass AND q_non_inferior) OR (q_pass AND auprc_non_inferior); MOVE (direction_pass AND rmse_non_inferior) OR (rmse_pass AND direction_non_inferior), 非劣条件属所在支、不得悬空); 满足者按冻结 screen score 排序取最多 2 个 A1-A4 候选 (可少于 2, 不替补); top2 freeze 需 A0_S17 complete + V542-A0-sanity-band pass
gate_preregistration.a1c_rule: A1 进 top2 集或被选 Backbone* 即激活 A1-C (3-layer, 第 3 层 fresh 用 A1 init stream) seed17 full-dose diagnostic (需 H0 fixture + conditional smoke 200 + 40+40 profile + cost gate + 预算记录); 否则 gate_skipped(a1_not_in_top2_and_not_selected), 归因未解决写明; 不加入 C2
gate_preregistration.a5_rule: A5 smoke/profile/diagnostic 先行不等待; full-dose 仅当 A1-A4 top2 三 seed 最终 H3 无人合格时自动激活 (需 diagnostic/cost/H0/H1 全过, 无裁量); 否则 gate_skipped; A5 seed17 full-dose 完成且 seed17_screen_pass 后 A5 supplement (S29/S43, 最多 2 runs) 激活
gate_preregistration.a5c_rule: A5-C 仅当 A5 被选为 Backbone* 时激活 (2 个交替 GRUCell T4 hidden48, 第二 cell 用 A5 init stream, full-dose 诊断非 winner); 若 A5 H3 合格但未被选, 记 capacity_caveat_unresolved, 不跑
